title: View colors terminals via node id == SCENARIO_SOURCE — presentation keyed to the golden fixture
evidence:
const FLinearColor Color = Node.Kind == PP::FNodeKind::Terminal
									   ? (Node.Id == PP::SCENARIO_SOURCE ? kSourceNode : kSinkNode)

(PPViewSnapshot.h:23 — the view model carries no src/sink role: `PP::FNodeKind Kind = PP::FNodeKind::Terminal;` — only Terminal/Junction exist)
detail: The snapshot has no source-vs-sink role, so the view improvises with the probe scenario's fixture id (SCENARIO_SOURCE == 0). Every terminal whose id isn't 0 renders sink-blue — wrong the moment any fixture grows (1.4 arena variants, 5.x growth).
recommended_fix: Add a terminal role (Source/Sink) to FNodeView (run setup knows it) and switch the palette on that; keep PP_Scenario.h constants out of the view.

title: AGENTS.md still says bUseFixedFrameRate 'is pinned' — contradicts the deliberate False
evidence:
Config/DefaultEngine.ini:
bUseFixedFrameRate=False

AGENTS.md line 55 (unchanged by this diff):
- **Fixed tick:** the sim steps at 20 Hz (ODN-2; `bUseFixedFrameRate` is
  pinned in `Config/DefaultEngine.ini`).
detail: The r2 decision (sim rate owned by the driver; render at display rate) is well documented in the ini, but the agent contract still reads as if the pin is True — a future agent following AGENTS.md could re-pin it and silently re-break the 60 fps easing.
recommended_fix: Update the AGENTS.md 'Fixed tick' line to say the sim rate is owned by FPPSimDriver (ODN-2) and bUseFixedFrameRate is deliberately False.

title: FPPScreenFit lives in PPCommandBus.h, so view geometry depends on the command bus
evidence:
#include "PPCommandBus.h" // FPPScreenFit

(PPRunView.h likewise includes PPCommandBus.h; the struct FPPScreenFit is defined in PPCommandBus.h:21-52)
detail: The shared screen↔grid fit is single-sourced (good — it closed the r1 dual-fit warning) but housed in the command-bus header, making the pure view-geometry module and the widget depend on the input bus for math that is neither's concern.
recommended_fix: Move FPPScreenFit/MakeScreenFit into its own small header (e.g. PPViewFit.h) that the bus, view, and geometry all include.

title: ZeroVector sentinel conflates 'packet absent from snapshot' with 'packet at grid (0,0)'
evidence:
const bool bInPrev = PPViewGeometry::PacketGridPos(PrevSnapshot, Packet.Id) != FVector2D::ZeroVector;

(PPViewGeometry.h:69: `return FVector2D::ZeroVector; // not in this snapshot (spawned/culled)`)
detail: Presence is inferred from the position value: a packet legitimately at/near tile (0,0) reads as absent-from-prev and skips its glide (snaps instead). Harmless on the slice-1 fixture (nodes at x=2..10) but grid (0,0) is a valid tile for future maps.
recommended_fix: Give PacketGridPos an out-param bool bFound (or have FPacketView carry snapshot presence) instead of overloading the zero vector.
